purpose: Teach: 従兄弟/見分け/嫌っ/よくなる/こらえ/探さ/さして/ペンキ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、従兄弟、絶対、ヤバいって聞いたぜ
lines.en: Riku, I heard your cousin is seriously incredible.
lines.style: Casual, direct opening. Slight tease underneath. Leaning in like sharing gossip. Even pace, eyebrow raised. Playful challenge in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、双子の、本気で、絶対、見分け、絶対、つくか?桜、本気for
lines.en: You—can you actually tell the twins apart, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question. Light, almost flustered underneath. Quick delivery to dodge the comment. Slight nervous energy masked by cool distance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、嫌っ、絶対、てた野菜、絶対、食べられるようになったか?本気で
lines.en: Riku, seriously—you can actually eat the vegetables you used to hate now?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through the teasing. Slight lift at the question mark. Warm undertone—actually interested in the answer, not just needling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト、本気で、絶対、よくなる、絶対、よな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores are actually getting better, aren't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter shift. Sincere observation delivered like a small compliment. Gentle, almost careful. Not bragging—just stating what he's noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、こらえ、絶対、性、絶対、ないな
lines.en: Riku, you seriously don't have the patience for this, do you?
lines.style: Sharp little laugh underneath. Teasing but affectionate. Quick rhythm. Slight head tilt—she knows exactly what he's like and enjoys it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、参考書、絶対、探さ、絶対、なきゃならんよな、桜
lines.en: You're going to have to find a study guide, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction wrapped in care. Steady, no-nonsense delivery. Slight pause before her name—he's being practical because he cares.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、さして、絶対、勉強してねえだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're not actually studying that much, are you?
lines.style: Caught-you tone. Light, knowing smile in the voice. Slow on 'not-especially,' drawing it out. The comfort of calling him out without judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ペンキ、絶対、塗り、絶対、文化祭、絶対、手伝えよ、桜
lines.en: You're going to help me paint for the festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Not a question. Quiet certainty. Half-request, half-expectation. The tone of someone who knows they can count on you and isn't shy about asking.
